leads.headline: TRUMP PUTS IRAN WAR DECISION OFF TO 2027
leads.detail: Asked about action against Iran, Trump says he will see what happens after Jan. 1.
leads.illustration_note: A missile on a launcher silhouetted against a dusk sky over a desert city skyline, with a large calendar page reading 2027 beside it.

leads.headline: WORLD COURT FINDS MYANMAR COMMITTED GENOCIDE
leads.detail: In The Gambia case over Rohingya, the ICJ rules 9-6 on the 2016-17 crackdown.
leads.illustration_note: A judge's gavel above a set of scales, courthouse columns behind.

leads.headline: ANTHROPIC CLOSES FIRST DAY UP 17%
leads.detail: The AI company's record $81.3bn IPO values it at about $1.76tn at close.
leads.illustration_note: A microchip with a bold green rising arrow and bar chart breaking through its top, city skyline below.

leads.headline: RUSSIAN STRIKES HIT KYIV; EMBASSIES DAMAGED
leads.detail: Overnight attacks damage Dutch and Austrian embassy buildings; a residential strike kills one.
leads.illustration_note: A night skyline with two bright explosion bursts and a damaged apartment block, searchlight beams.

leads.headline: ADNOC VESSEL ATTACKED IN STRAIT OF HORMUZ
leads.detail: One crew member is missing after an attack; separate reports describe a tanker fire.
leads.illustration_note: A large oil tanker on stylised waves passing through a narrow strait between two headlands, a small fire/smoke plume at its stern.

leads.headline: HERZOG TAPS EISENKOT TO FORM ISRAELI GOVERNMENT
leads.detail: The president tasks Netanyahu challenger Gadi Eisenkot with trying to build a coalition.
leads.illustration_note: A ballot paper sliding into a ballot box in front of a domed parliament building.

leads.headline: CYCLONE AKVAN APPROACHES INDIA'S ODISHA COAST
leads.detail: More than 80,000 people are evacuated ahead of expected landfall.
leads.illustration_note: A big spiral cyclone seen from the side/front over a curving coastline, bent palm trees, a line of tiny figures with bundles walking inland along an arrow.

leads.headline: TAIWAN TIGHTENS RULES AS STOCKS SLIDE
leads.detail: Regulators announce stabilising steps and short-sale curbs after a steep three-day fall.
leads.illustration_note: A steeply falling red stock chart line with a large hand pressing a STOP octagon onto it.

leads.headline: DRONE SCARE HALTS FLIGHTS AT GENOA AIRPORT
leads.detail: Unidentified drones prompt an overnight suspension of airport operations.
leads.illustration_note: A quadcopter drone hovering over an airport runway at night, a parked passenger plane with its lights off, a control tower.

leads.headline: UKRAINE'S EUROPEAN ALLIES OPEN TO RUSSIA TALKS
leads.detail: Leaders in Berlin say Europe has a united negotiating position and is ready for talks.
leads.illustration_note: Two hands shaking across a table over a simple map outline, two small flags behind.

leads.headline: FOUR COUNTRIES URGE AID ACCESS TO FLOODED GAZA
leads.detail: Australia, Canada, Italy and the UK call for immediate, unrestricted humanitarian access.
leads.illustration_note: Aid trucks with AID crates beside tents standing in floodwater under rain streaks.

leads.headline: GIANT STAR SEEN SWALLOWING ITS COMPANION
leads.detail: Astronomers report a seven-year observation of a star engulfing another in Andromeda.
leads.illustration_note: Deep-space panel: one large glowing star pulling a spiral stream of light from a smaller companion star, a small telescope silhouette at the bottom corner.

briefs.text: Houthis claim strikes on four Saudi targets; Riyadh reports damage to a landmark building.
Israeli airstrike hits a Hezbollah missile facility in eastern Lebanon.
Israeli military completes a ground operation in Gaza beyond the Yellow Line.
France braces for a fourth weekend of cost-of-living protests.
One dead and 15 injured after fire in an 18-storey French apartment block.
South Korea's annual exports pass $1 trillion for the first time.
California opens a probe into Nvidia AI-chip sales to China.
Cyber incidents at JPMorgan, Visa and Mastercard expose customer data.
Trump posthumously pardons baseball star Pete Rose.
Trump backs firing of US cyber chief Sean Cairncross amid tech outages.
State Department details $12bn in Venezuelan oil and mineral revenue.
India-Japan talks: Japanese forces to train on Indian firing ranges from 2027.
Japan's Takaichi says Tokyo's Taiwan stance is unchanged.
COP31 AI pledge draws no major US technology companies.
BBC reports families trapped as Houthis hold Yemen's besieged Taiz.
India's Justice Varma tells parliament resignation is not an admission of guilt.
India bowl New Zealand out for 368 on day two of Wellington Test.
South Africa captain Bavuma ruled out of Bangladesh series decider.
Wet first practice curtails running at the Las Vegas Grand Prix.
Fiona the hippo dies at Cincinnati Zoo after swallowing a hat.
Oil prices flat as Hormuz disruption offsets oversupply concerns.
Trump warns APEC nations strict AI rules could stifle development.
Trump returns from China and holds a White House press conference.
Indian public-sector banks post record half-year profit of about Rs 1.10 lakh crore.
US Navy blockades Iranian shipping in the Strait of Hormuz; Tehran threatens Gulf oil facilities.
COP31 in Antalya: activists denounce the draft text as fossil-fuel talks stall.
US embassy in Mexico: Chinese chemical precursors were bound for the Sinaloa cartel.
Bessent: Trump and Xi agree humans must oversee military AI decisions.
Ukrainian strikes bring down a Crimean Bridge span; fuel limits imposed in Sevastopol.
Kramatorsk: an aerial bomb hits a bus, killing at least 30 people.
Microsoft 365 outage disrupts Outlook and Teams worldwide for over nine hours.
Two Russian Tu-95 bombers enter Taiwan's air-defence zone; Taipei scrambles jets.
German police arrest two Dutch nationals suspected of a Frankfurt bomb plot.
Hungary lifts its veto on opening EU accession negotiating clusters with Ukraine.
Johannesburg: ANC seeks a coalition without the DA, which topped the municipal polls.
Gambia: a candidate withdraws, leaving eight in the 5 December presidential race.
California voters reject a billionaire tax; Washington keeps its millionaire levy.
New Zealand court rules the government's pay-equity reform violated women's rights.

date_check: LEFT OUT (other days): Trump-Xi-Putin trilateral summit and peace declaration in Shenzhen (19 Nov) - GTA VI launch and reviews (19 Nov) - Nvidia's $115.8bn quarter (17 Nov) - US strike on Qeshm Island (18 Nov) - Alaska Senate result giving Democrats a majority (18 Nov).
closing: All stories first reported Friday 20 November 2026
